repo.name: libxcrypt
repo.description: Extended crypt library for descrypt, md5crypt, bcrypt, and others

readme.summary: Well-written library documentation that explains purpose and configuration clearly, but lacks practical usage examples and quick-start code for developers integrating the library.
readme.top_issue: No code examples showing how to actually use the crypt() functions in a program - only build/configure documentation

critical_findings: Potential buffer overflow vulnerability in the function make_failure_token if 'size' is not properly validated.
Use of insecure MD4 hash algorithm in the function crypt_nt_rn.
security.summary: The code has some security concerns, including potential input validation issues and use of an insecure hash algorithm, but overall it appears to be well-structured and secure.

common_complaints: Compilation failures with different compiler versions (GCC 11+, Clang on macOS)
Linker compatibility issues (LLD, version script symbol resolution)
Platform-specific test failures (PowerPC, Debian 7 with old GCC)
Documentation gaps and unclear behavior in man pages
sentiment.summary: libxcrypt shows signs of active maintenance with bugs being addressed and closed, though current open issues indicate ongoing compilation and platform-specific challenges that may affect downstream users.

communication.summary: Maintainer responses are generally clear and helpful, showing a good level of technical depth and patience with contributors.
